pt-br: This is Brazilian Portuguese, not European Portuguese. Use Brazilian vocabulary and spelling throughout.
A browser tab is 'guia' (plural 'guias'), never 'aba'. This includes 'nova guia' for the new tab page, 'grupo de guias', and 'Guias' as the name of the Tabs plugin.
For enabling or disabling a feature or setting use 'ativar' / 'desativar' (and 'ativado' / 'desativado'), never 'habilitar' / 'desabilitar'.
